business: Auto Clinic (AUTOCLINIC) - Car Detailing, PPF and Coating Studio, Llumar partner, Ahmedabad

checks.claim: Business exists as described, single end business (not a namesake, chain or agency)
checks.note: Re-opened grasi.in Llumar locator (row Auto Clinic, Near Iscon Flyover, Bellagio Road 380053, 9909956565, @autoclinic_ahmedabad, no website, (c) 2025 footer, undated), localeye.in (Car Spa & Detailing, Iscon Ambli Rd 380058, same phone, no website) and Instagram @autoclinic_ahmedabad (4,546 followers, since 2017, Llumar USA PPF partner, no link/phone/WhatsApp in bio). Three sources agree it exists. No multi-outlet claim seen. The Garware PPF Ahmedabad page does not list it (not a conflict, different film brand).

Not reproduced on localeye (rating and reviews 'not listed') nor anywhere else. My searches for this studio in the same Ambli/Iscon area returned only CarzSpa Ambli, whose listings show about 4.6 stars with about 239 reviews: the finder very likely picked up the neighbouring franchise's rating. Treat the rating as unknown and probably wrong.

checks.claim: Need: no own website, so slot c (no website button) applies
checks.note: Absence of a site across a locator, a directory and an Instagram bio is a negative finding. The Google Maps website button, reviews, review replies and Maps-published phone were never seen by anyone. No campaign slot a/b/c/d is provable. Need is inferred only (dossier says so correctly). Searches for an official site return nothing, which is also consistent with weak indexing.

checks.claim: Phone 9909956565 is the business's own number and reaches the owner
checks.note: Number appears on the Llumar dealer row (a supplier-maintained page, plausibly filled by the studio) and on localeye (a scraped-style directory, probably copied from Maps/Justdial). Two sources are not fully independent. Not seen on Maps or Instagram. Row names two people (Vaibhav Solanki / Sagar Jethva) and the email is a personal-style Gmail, so whose mobile this is stays unknown. owner_direct_contact 'probably' is generous; 'unknown' is the honest value. A web search for the number returned nothing.

Evidence is: Llumar partner badge, since 2017, 4.5k Instagram followers, and a localeye line claiming more than 3,000 customers (unverified directory copy). No ads checked, no review count, no price signals. 'Moderate' is the fair label; Llumar partnership shows they sell PPF, not that they will pay Rs 15-25k plus Rs 5k a month for a page. They also already get leads via Llumar locator and Instagram, which raises resistance.

Two different addresses (Bellagio Road near Iscon Flyover, beside Maruti 360, pin 380053 versus Ambli Road beside Rajwadi Tea Stall, pin 380058). Could be one place described two ways, but it is unreconciled, and the Ambli Road description is the same stretch as CarzSpa Ambli. Risk of mixing listings.

checks.claim: Best channel: WhatsApp/call to 9909956565 after owner confirms it is on Maps
checks.note: The dossier itself says do not use the number cold unless it is on Maps. Under the campaign rules (reachable on the mobile the studio publishes on its Google listing) the channel precondition is unmet, so nothing can be sent today.

strongest_objection: Nothing the campaign requires has actually been observed: the gap (website button, reviews, owner replies) and the Maps-published phone are all unseen, so the whole lead rests on 'no website found' from a supplier locator and a directory, plus a 4.6 rating that is probably CarzSpa Ambli's, and an unproven owner mobile.
corrections: Drop the finder's 4.6 rating; it is unreproduced and likely belongs to the neighbouring CarzSpa Ambli.
ability_to_pay: moderate, not strong (no ad, review or price evidence).
owner_direct_contact: unknown, not 'probably' (two named principals, personal Gmail, number not seen on Maps or Instagram).
need_evidence stays inferred; safe_first_message_slot is none until a human looks at the Google listing.

ready_for_campaign stays false. To earn B: a manual look at the Google Maps listing confirming the same phone is published there and the website button is missing or opens Instagram, plus review dates and owner replies. To earn A: add a running Meta ad or a clearly named owner with a verified mobile.
